heading: INT. SUNSET BARN - WEDDING AFTERPARTY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SUNSET BARN - WEDDING AFTERPARTY - NIGHT
String lights sway over a dance floor littered with confetti and shoes.
A half-eaten cake leans like a tower in Pisa.
The DJ booth glows, empty, still thumping a bass line nobody is dancing to.
On the cake table, a plastic bride-and-groom topper wobbles.
Then, impossibly, climbs down.
GUS, a wiry corgi in a tiny bow tie, trots in, dragging a garter in his teeth.
BEA, 20s, the bride's sibling, in a rumpled suit, tie loose, hair wild, vaults a chair and skids to a stop in front of him.
Bea is out of breath, and they are grinning like a person who has just won something.
Gus! Drop the garter, buddy. That belongs to the bouquet relay.
units.name: BEA

units.text: Gus drops it.
Then snatches it back.
BOING, his tail whips a candle holder, and a tower of cups topples with a CRASH.
Sorry, Captain Bea! The relay's the only game I'm any good at!
units.name: GUS

units.text: Nobody's saying you're not good. They're saying you cheat.
units.name: BEA

units.text: I do not cheat. I take shortcuts.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Bea laughs and crouches.
They point to the finish line, a ribbon strung between two keg stands at the far end of the barn.
Okay, Gus-Gus, ground rules. Garter in mouth, no teeth on the ribbon, and nobody bites the best man.
units.name: BEA

units.text: That was ONE time!
units.name: GUS

units.text: A starter pistol, actually a champagne cork, POPS from the balcony.
The crowd, offscreen, ROARS.
Bea sprints.
Gus scrambles after them, paws skittering on the polished boards.
Over a fallen chair.
Under a table.
WHOOSH past a sleeping uncle.
The garter flutters like a flag.
Left, Gus, left!
units.name: BEA

units.text: I know where left is! I'm a professional!
units.name: GUS

units.text: They hit the ribbon together.
SNAP.
Streamers rain down.
Gus tumbles into Bea's arms, and they both go down laughing on a pile of discarded party hats.
Photo finish. Tie game.
units.name: BEA

units.text: Rematch at the honeymoon?
units.name: GUS

units.text: Don't push your luck, champ.
units.name: BEA

units.text: Gus puts the garter on Bea's head like a crown.
Bea lets him.
